upstreams.name: DedSec
upstreams.license_evidence: Cached README states MIT, but direct GitHub page/API and LICENSE blob returned 404 during 2026-11-24 audit. Treat license as unverified.
upstreams.graphics_path: README claims RDNA2 gfx1030 to HLSL Shader Model 6.6 to DXIL and native D3D12
upstreams.notes: Cached repository page listed 37 commits and source folders; no immutable HEAD SHA or source files could be retrieved. README claims 26,503 shaders/1,630 instruction forms, GDeflate, XTaskQueue, XAudio2, input adapter, FSR3, VRS, async compute and cache systems. README explicitly marks PE loader/import shims partial, Xbox D3D12 ABI proxy in progress, real game boot pending and in-game play not achieved. See docs/DEDSEC_AUDIT.md. AMD's official ROCm table identifies RX 6600 as gfx1032, while README emphasizes gfx1030; exact compatibility requires testing.
